transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… mainly work stuff. I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish reviewing claims. It’s been hard to manage.
Do you feel anxious when you're sitting at your workstation?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t really call it anxious. I just kind of get uncomfortable sitting there, I guess.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
Not really. I mean, I get stuff stuck in my head sometimes, like anyone, but I wouldn’t say there are thoughts repeating over and over.
Do you feel like you have to get up from your workstation for some reason?
Yeah… I guess I do. It’s not like a specific reason, really. I just keep getting up from my desk during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews.
Do you feel like you have to get up from your workstation to do something specific?
No, not really something specific. I just… end up getting up from my desk a lot, even though I know I’m supposed to stay there and get through the claim reviews.
Do you feel like you're getting up from your desk because you have to, or because you want to?
More like I just… feel like I can’t stay put, I guess. I don’t really want to get up for anything, but I keep doing it when I’m supposed to be at my desk finishing the claim reviews.
Do you feel like getting up from your desk is something you have to do to make something feel right or to prevent something from happening?

No… not like that. It doesn’t feel like I’m preventing something or making things “right.” It’s more just that I keep getting up from my workstation when I’m supposed to be staying there and finishing the claim reviews.
Do you feel like you're getting up from your desk because something is compelling you to do so?
Not like… compelled in that way, no. It’s more just that I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews.
Do you feel restless when you're sitting at your workstation?

Yeah… sometimes. More in longer trainings or team meetings, I notice I’m bouncing my leg or clicking a pen, shifting around in the chair. I try to look like I’m paying attention, but I’m kind of moving the whole time.
Do you often feel worried or on edge when you're not getting up from your desk?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can get kind of uncomfortable sitting there too long, but I wouldn’t really call it worried or on edge.
Do you feel like you need to move your body when you're sitting at your workstation?
Yeah, I guess so. Mostly in longer meetings or trainings I’ll bounce my leg or click my pen, or just keep shifting in the chair even when I’m trying to seem focused.
Do you feel like you get up from your desk because you need to move around?
Yeah… I think so. I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews. It’s kind of the main reason I came in.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking through the consequences?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I do that a lot… not in any big way that I’ve noticed.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting with things, like tapping your hands or feet, when you're sitting still?
Yeah… mostly in trainings or longer meetings. I’ll bounce my leg or click my pen, or just keep shifting around in the chair even if I’m trying to sit still.
Do you often do things without thinking them through?
Not really, no. I mean… I might do little things without planning, but I don’t think it’s something that happens a lot or causes major problems.
Do you feel like you need to move around a lot in your daily life, not just when you're sitting at your desk?
Yeah… mostly at work. I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews. It’s kind of why I came in.
Do you have trouble paying attention to tasks or activities?

Yeah… I do. Like if people near me start talking about another claim, or I suddenly remember some errand, I kind of lose the thread of what I’m reading. Then I have to go back and reread the same section a few times.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're not at your workstation?
Yeah, sometimes. In trainings or longer team meetings, I’ll catch myself bouncing my leg or clicking a pen… shifting around in the chair. I try not to make it obvious.
Do you have difficulty completing tasks because you lose focus or get distracted?

Yeah. I’ll be reading through a claim and if people nearby start talking, or I remember some random errand, I kind of lose where I was. Then I end up rereading the same part a few times before I can keep going.
Do you have trouble paying attention to tasks or activities outside of work as well?
Yeah… outside work too, sometimes. Like if someone near me starts talking, or I remember some random errand, I’ll lose my place in what I’m reading and have to go back over the same part a few times.
